Lina (People Ops): Putting this thread up for clarifying international per-diem, currency conversions, lost receipts, and spouse/guest rules for travel reimbursements. Need to update the travel one-pager.
Omar (BizDev): Do we have a simple rule for converting foreign receipts? I often get docs in EUR/INR and its a pain for expense uploads.
Priya (Finance): We use the bank FX rate on the transaction date for corporate card charges. For out-of-pocket reimbursements, use XE (or our expense tools builtin rate) for the date of purchase, and attach a screenshot of the rate if the charge is > 500 USD equivalent.
Jules (Ops): What about cash receipts and local taxis where no receipt is provided?
Priya (Finance): Cash: receipts required when available. If unavoidably missing (e.g., tiny local taxi), submit a written explanation in the "lost/missing receipt" field and tag manager approval. Finance may require a supplementary attestation form for missing receipts > $50.
Lina (People Ops): Spouse/guest expenses? Some teams asked if we can cover a partner for dinners when attending a conference.
Priya (Finance): By default we do NOT reimburse spouse/guest travel or meals. Exceptions for business justification (e.g., hosting a client) require pre-approval from manager + Finance and notes in TravelPerk booking. If pre-approved, only the business portion is reimbursable.
Omar (BizDev): How do we handle partial travel days for per diem? If I fly out midday and return late evening the same day, is there a split?
Priya (Finance): Per diem split: full day for overnight stay days. For travel days less than 12 hours with no overnight, no per diem. If overnight, pro-rate per our daily schedule: breakfast/lunch/dinner values are fixed in the policy appendix (breakfast 20%, lunch 30%, dinner 50% of total per diem). Add that to FAQ.
Jules (Ops): Are conference registration fees pre-approved as billable? Some events have VIP dinners.
Priya (Finance): Registration fees are billable with receipt. Conference-sponsored social events that are optional are not reimbursable unless pre-approved. Host/mandatory networking dinners noted by the organizer are reimbursable; attach event schedule.
Lina (People Ops): What about advance payments and travel advances for contractors?
Priya (Finance): Contractors can request an advance via the Travel Advance form. Advances are reconciled within 15 business days after trip end. Any unspent advance must be returned or deducted from final invoice.
Omar (BizDev): Is travel insurance covered? We had a cancelled flight last week.
Jules (Ops): Yes, for company-booked international trips we automatically include basic travel insurance; for personal bookings add-ons, expense only if pre-approved and business-necessary.
TravelBot: Reminder: expense submissions must use our T&E tool and include receipts for amounts >= $25. Missing receipt flow: upload affidavit + manager sign-off for missing receipts > $50. Automated link: https://redwood.example/internal/expenses/missing-receipt
Priya (Finance): Quick checklist to add to policy: 1) Use corporate booking tools (TravelPerk) when possible; 2) Corporate card for flights/hotels; 3) Use bank FX rate for card charges, XE for reimbursements (attach rate if >$500); 4) Receipts required >= $25; 5) Lost receipt affidavit for >$50; 6) No spouse expenses without pre-approval; 7) Submit within 60 days.
Lina (People Ops): Can we add a short "how to" for uploading multi-currency receipts? Some users are attaching many PDFs and the tool flags them.
Priya (Finance): Tip: combine same-day receipts into a single PDF per category, include a summary line in the expense form with original currency, converted amount, and exchange rate used. The T&E tool accepts a single PDF up to 10MB.
Omar (BizDev): Any special rules for per-diem vs receipts when entertaining clients?
Priya (Finance): When entertaining clients, receipts are required regardless of per-diem. Use "Client Entertainment" category and attach attendee list + business purpose. Meals under client entertainment are excluded from personal per diem.
Jules (Ops): Lost baggage expenses? I had to buy essentials once.
Priya (Finance): Essentials (clothing/toiletries) reimbursable with receipt if baggage delayed and items are necessary for business. Keep it reasonable; Finance will review reasonableness case-by-case.
Lina (People Ops): I'll draft a short FAQ + flowchart for pre-approval and lost receipts and post tomorrow. One more: expedited reimbursements for relocation or urgent vendor payments?
Priya (Finance): We can do expedited reimbursement if tagged "expedite" and approved by manager + Finance ops. Expect 2-3 business days processing for expedite vs standard payroll cycle for normal claims.
Lina (People Ops): Ok great. I'll include examples and the small JSON snippet people can use when scripting uploads. Please review before I publish.
